claims.claim: Researchers at Eastern Connecticut State University identified previously unknown microbial communities in scorpion venom using novel sequencing techniques.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at Eastern Connecticut State University identified previously unknown microbial communities in scorpion venom using novel sequencing techniques.
claims.source_title: CT researchers make discovery that could fight antibiotic resistance. It lies in venomous arachnids
claims.supporting_quote: A breakthrough study by researchers at Eastern Connecticut State University has refuted the long-held scientific belief that scorpion venom is sterile, after researchers using cutting-edge technology to discover new living microbes.

claims.claim: University of St Andrews researchers obtained full nuclear and mitochondrial genomes from 58 blow samples of 26 North Pacific humpback whales with approximately 84 percent of the DNA coming from the whale.
claims.episode_span: University of St Andrews researchers, working with the University of Copenhagen, North Coast Cetacean Society and Fisheries and Oceans Canada, obtained full nuclear and mitochondrial genomes from 58 blow samples of 26 North Pacific humpback whales. Approximately 84 percent of the DNA in each sample came from the whale.
claims.source_title: Humpback whale snot unlocks whole-genome sequencing without invasive sampling
claims.supporting_quote: Scientists collected 58 blow samples from 26 individual humpback whales. About 84% of the DNA in the blow came from the whale itself.

claims.claim: A 13-protein panel plus clinical variables predicted insulin sensitivity measured by hyperinsulinaemic–euglycaemic clamp with an R² of 0.67 in 161 individuals.
claims.episode_span: A 13-protein panel plus clinical variables predicted insulin sensitivity measured by hyperinsulinaemic–euglycaemic clamp with an R² of 0.67 in 161 individuals.
claims.source_title: Plasma proteins for the win again....better prediction of Type 2 diabetes, liver, kidney, heart, and other diseases than currently used metrics
claims.supporting_quote: We further developed a model combining 13 proteins, including IGFBP1, LEP, GDF15, PON3 and LDLR, with clinical variables (sex, HbA1c and the triglyceride-to-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio) to predict insulin sensitivity ( R 2 = 0.67).

claims.claim: Advances in nanotechnology now allow ultrathin components that control light at scales below its wavelength.

claims.supporting_quote: advances in nanotechnology are enabling a different approach. Researchers can now engineer materials at scales smaller than the wavelength of light, creating ultrathin optical components
